content.rendered:
Round Silver Thal With 6 Tea Cups + 1 Milk Pot

There’s a bit of a mix-up here since the image doesn’t show a milk pot. What it does show is a beautifully presented round silver decorative plate (or thal) secured in a dark brown box lined with brown satin. The plate has a crackle pattern design with a decorative border around its edge. In the same box, but in a separate compartment below the plate, there are six elegant white tea cups. These cups have handles and are carefully nestled in brown satin fabric for protection and a touch of luxury. The box itself is dark brown with silver clasps on the front and is presented against a clean, plain white background, highlighting the items inside. Bring a touch of elegance and sophistication to your tea-time rituals with this beautifully designed Round Silver Thal Tea Set. Thoughtfully crafted to impress your guests, this set comes with six classic tea cups and a stylish milk pot, all placed on a graceful round silver thal (tray). The silver-finished tray features a stunning embossed border pattern, adding a regal charm to your serving experience. It’s not just functional but also a piece of art that elevates the look of your dining or living space. Each cup is made from high-quality material in a sleek white finish with delicate silver lining, blending modern simplicity with timeless elegance. Perfect for family gatherings, high-tea sessions, festivals, and special occasions, this set will instantly make your presentation more appealing. Its sturdy build ensures it can handle regular use, while the smooth finish makes it easy to clean and maintain. Whether you’re entertaining guests, enjoying a quiet evening tea, or looking for a premium gift for loved ones, this tea set is a complete solution.
